title: Check Tote Exchange Settings thresholds (queue/pickup/priority/close) on the Aveva API page
summary: Inspect the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page to verify the configured tote exchange threshold parameters (Cube and/or Count: Pickup, Priority, Close), the weight-related fields (Maximum Weight and Weight Threshold), and the selected Method option (Count, Cube, or Cube and Count).
when_to_use: Use when you need to confirm that the Tote Exchange Settings thresholds and Method selection on the Aveva API page match the intended tote exchange threshold concept (queue/pickup/priority/close) and that the expected fields are present and readable.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for correcting missing/incorrect configuration values when the correct interface/version or field mapping is unclear—escalate if fields cannot be found.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page and verify the presence and values of the named threshold fields and Method selection.
access_or_tools_needed: Aveva API access to the Tote Exchange Settings interface/page
Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page UI showing threshold and method fields

access_required: Aveva API access to the Tote Exchange Settings interface/page

visual_references.description: Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page frame showing Cube Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close, Count Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close, Maximum Weight/Weight Threshold, and Method options (Count/Cube/Cube and Count).

steps.title: Open the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page
steps.purpose: Get to the correct Aveva API interface where tote exchange threshold parameters and Method selection are displayed.
steps.instruction: Open the Tote Exchange Settings interface on the Aveva API page so you can view the threshold and Method fields.
steps.expected_result: The Tote Exchange Settings interface is visible, including the threshold fields and the Method field.
steps.healthy_condition: The page shows the Tote Exchange Settings interface with named fields for Cube thresholds, Count thresholds, weight-related parameters, and Method.
steps.failure_condition: The Tote Exchange Settings interface cannot be opened, or the expected named fields are not visible.

actions.label: Open Tote Exchange Settings page
actions.exact_action: Open the Aveva API page for the Tote Exchange Settings interface.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Tote Exchange Settings page/interface cannot be found or opened, stop and escalate to the support/project team for guidance on the correct interface/version.

steps.title: Locate Cube Threshold Pickup, Cube Threshold Priority, and Cube Threshold Close
steps.purpose: Verify the Cube-based threshold values for the tote exchange queue/pickup/priority/close concept.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page, locate the Cube threshold fields labeled Cube Threshold Pickup, Cube Threshold Priority, and Cube Threshold Close.
steps.expected_result: Cube Threshold Pickup, Cube Threshold Priority, and Cube Threshold Close fields are present and readable on the page.
steps.healthy_condition: All three Cube threshold fields are visible on the Tote Exchange Settings page.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the Cube threshold fields (Pickup/Priority/Close) are missing or cannot be found on the page.

actions.label: Find Cube threshold fields
actions.exact_action: Locate the threshold fields for Cube: Cube Threshold Pickup, Cube Threshold Priority, and Cube Threshold Close.

stop_or_escalate_if: If Cube Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close fields are missing or cannot be found, stop and escalate to support/project team for guidance on the correct interface/version.

steps.title: Locate Count Threshold Pickup, Count Threshold Priority, and Count Threshold Close
steps.purpose: Verify the Count-based threshold values for the tote exchange queue/pickup/priority/close concept.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page, locate the Count threshold fields labeled Count Threshold Pickup, Count Threshold Priority, and Count Threshold Close.
steps.expected_result: Count Threshold Pickup, Count Threshold Priority, and Count Threshold Close fields are present and readable on the page.
steps.healthy_condition: All three Count threshold fields are visible on the Tote Exchange Settings page.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the Count threshold fields (Pickup/Priority/Close) are missing or cannot be found on the page.

actions.label: Find Count threshold fields
actions.exact_action: Locate the threshold fields for Count: Count Threshold Pickup, Count Threshold Priority, and Count Threshold Close.

stop_or_escalate_if: If Count Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close fields are missing or cannot be found, stop and escalate to support/project team for guidance on the correct interface/version.

steps.title: Locate Maximum Weight and Weight Threshold
steps.purpose: Confirm the weight-related parameters are present on the Tote Exchange Settings page.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page, locate the weight-related fields labeled Maximum Weight and Weight Threshold.
steps.expected_result: Maximum Weight and Weight Threshold fields are present and readable on the page.
steps.healthy_condition: Both weight-related fields are visible on the Tote Exchange Settings page.
steps.failure_condition: One or both weight-related fields are missing or cannot be found on the page.

actions.label: Find weight fields
actions.exact_action: Locate the weight-related fields: Maximum Weight and Weight Threshold.

stop_or_escalate_if: If Maximum Weight and/or Weight Threshold fields are missing or cannot be found, stop and escalate to support/project team for guidance on the correct interface/version.

steps.title: Confirm Method selection (Count, Cube, or Cube and Count)
steps.purpose: Verify which evaluation method is selected for tote exchange thresholds.
steps.instruction: On the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page, locate the Method field and confirm it is set to one of the options: Count, Cube, or Cube and Count.
steps.expected_result: The Method field shows one of the allowed options: Count, Cube, or Cube and Count.
steps.healthy_condition: Method selection is visible and matches one of the listed options (Count/Cube/Cube and Count).
steps.failure_condition: Method field is missing, or it shows a value outside the expected options.

actions.label: Check Method option
actions.exact_action: Locate the Method field and confirm it is set to one of the documented options: Count, Cube, or Cube and Count.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Method field is missing or cannot be found, stop and escalate to support/project team for guidance on the correct interface/version.

steps.title: Verify the configured thresholds correspond to the queue/pickup/priority/close concept
steps.purpose: Ensure the displayed threshold fields align with the intended tote exchange threshold categories (queue/pickup/priority/close).
steps.instruction: Using the Tote Exchange Settings page, confirm that the displayed threshold fields represent the queue/pickup/priority/close threshold concept (Cube and/or Count thresholds) and that the page groups/labels match the expected categories.
steps.expected_result: The page shows threshold categories for queue/pickup/priority/close via the labeled Cube and/or Count threshold fields.
steps.healthy_condition: Cube and/or Count threshold fields are labeled as Pickup, Priority, and Close, and the page includes the Method selection indicating how thresholds are evaluated.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not show the expected threshold categories/labels (Pickup/Priority/Close) or the threshold concept cannot be mapped to the displayed fields.

actions.label: Confirm threshold category mapping
actions.exact_action: Confirm the configured values correspond to the intended “queue / pick up / priority / close” threshold concept described in the source.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the expected fields cannot be found or the threshold categories cannot be mapped to the queue/pickup/priority/close concept, stop and escalate to support/project team for guidance on the correct interface/version.

success_criteria: Cube Threshold Pickup, Cube Threshold Priority, and Cube Threshold Close fields are present and readable on the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page.
Count Threshold Pickup, Count Threshold Priority, and Count Threshold Close fields are present and readable on the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page.
Maximum Weight and Weight Threshold fields are present and readable on the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page.
Method field is present and set to Count, Cube, or Cube and Count.
healthy_conditions: Tote Exchange Settings page displays the named threshold fields for both Cube and Count (Pickup/Priority/Close) and the weight-related fields (Maximum Weight/Weight Threshold).
Method field shows one of the allowed options: Count, Cube, Cube and Count.
failure_conditions: Any expected field (Cube Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close, Count Threshold Pickup/Priority/Close, Maximum Weight, Weight Threshold, Method) is missing or cannot be found on the page.
Method field is missing or not set to Count, Cube, or Cube and Count.
escalation_guidance: If any expected fields are missing or cannot be found on the Tote Exchange Settings Aveva API page, stop and escalate to the support/project team for guidance on the correct interface/version.
